CA.rationale: A processing/origin entry (command_estimate/represented_time) is explicitly linked to the same content item.

COD.rationale: Content (red) is identified and the same referent has an explicit origin/organization entry, providing a status/organization distinction.

A.rationale: An explicit processing/origin marker (command_estimate/represented_time) is tied to the same content item, linking processing/access condition to that content's representation.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifications (color labels and coordinate sets) are present.

D.rationale: Content identifications are presented alongside distinct origin/status metadata, separating 'what' from representation/origin.

O.rationale: The report states how content is presented (grid orientation) and includes explicit origin/representation fields tied to items.
